title: Why I try to eat lunch away from my desk
dek: A lunch break away from the screen, even a short one, helps the afternoon feel less like a blur.
body: For a long time, lunch for me meant eating over my keyboard while answering emails. It felt efficient. It also meant that by two o'clock I could not remember what I had eaten, and I felt more tired than when I started.

Now I try to step away, even if it is only for twenty minutes. I eat at the kitchen table or on a bench outside. I leave the laptop closed and let my eyes rest on something farther away than a screen.

It is a small change, and some days it is not possible. When I can do it, though, the afternoon goes better. I come back with a clearer head, and I make fewer mistakes on the work I rushed through before.
I also notice my food more, which sounds silly but matters. A sandwich tastes better when you are actually paying attention to it.
Today, take your lunch somewhere other than your desk, and leave your phone face down while you eat.
